decision: summary requests inside the 20 s window are combined into one sent when the window ends, with the newest conversation
why: dropping them leaves a stale summary until the next turn ends

decision: every request sent counts toward the 1,000 daily cap, refusals and errors included
why: a failing key must not retry without limit

decision: a model with no known price is charged at $10 / $50 per million tokens
why: ORFONI_SUMMARY_MODEL must not slip past the $2 cap

decision: the key is read on every request, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY wins over the file, and a key file other accounts can read is refused
why: adding or fixing the key needs no restart, and a readable key is a leak

decision: messages.create with the stop_reason refusal check before reading content, not messages.parse
why: parse reads the content first and throws on the partial JSON a refusal can leave

decision: repeated API failures log one line per distinct status, error type and message
why: the SDK message carries a request ID that changes every time and would defeat the dedupe
evidence: b550150 tests through the real SDK against a fake server

decision: Claude's final reply in the summary input is the latest assistant text after the last user message, null before Claude writes any
why: the status must not describe an earlier turn

decision: a new conversation after /clear drops the old summary along with the chat and tasks
why: the old summary describes the previous conversation

decision: memoryWarning is { availableBytes, totalBytes }, present only below 1.5 GiB available; the app does not show it yet
why: the plan named the field but not its shape

decision: a session keeps a new memory reading only when it changes significantly, so listSessions can lag by under 10 percent or 50 MB
why: one rule for broadcast and state keeps them consistent

decision: the version 2 state file also stores summaries, tasks, and the day's summary count and spend
why: otherwise a restart blanks every summary, shows wrong task counts, and resets the daily cap

decision: the hub sets CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS=1 in every session it starts or resumes; ORFONI_TASK_TOOLS=0 turns it off
why: Claude Code 2.1.311 hides TaskCreate and TaskUpdate from current models, so task progress never appeared; Manuel asked to see each session's progress
evidence: hub worker read the 2.1.311 gate; env-vars.md documents the variable; Playwright run against the old hub: Claude reported the tools unavailable
result: VERIFIED, live check 1 of 2 done in 16 s

decision: the summary key comes only from ~/.config/orfoni/anthropic-api-key; the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY route the plan named is removed
why: Claude Code bills a session to ANTHROPIC_API_KEY instead of the subscription, and tmux hands the starting environment to every new session
evidence: final review Important 1; readApiKey test with the variable stubbed

decision: summaries check the daily cap before reading a transcript and again before counting, and transcript reads run one at a time across sessions
why: a whole-transcript parse blocks the hub's only thread; the reviewer measured up to 400 ms per stretch and 1.8 GB for ten 80 MB transcripts at once
evidence: final review Important 2; two tests red then green

decision: regraded Minor to Important: hubStatus carries a problem (missing or refused key, cap pause, last failure since the last success) and the status bar shows it
why: with a wrong key the app said Summaries on and never said why, which is the first thing a new key setup hits
evidence: final review Minor 6, regraded by effect

decision: folded Minor 4 into the problem fix: an unreadable key path is a missing key with its reason, so hubStatus always answers
why: an EISDIR or EACCES made hubStatus fail and the VPS memory vanish from the app
evidence: readApiKey test with a directory at the key path

decision: regraded Minor to Important: the app shows the hub's memoryWarning as a dismissible note in the new session
why: the design requires a warning when a session starts with little memory free; the plan's app tasks had left it out
evidence: final review Minor 7, regraded against the spec

decision: the hub live suite removes its sessions after each check
why: every run left a dozen offline test sessions in the sidebar

decision: Minor 5, a blank ANTHROPIC_API_KEY counting as a key, needs no fix
why: the variable is no longer read

decision: declined to judge, ruled to stand: earlyoom kills and a kill of the pane's own claude add no notice; memory.current includes page cache; a selected session counts as read; answers during a hub outage count as read; no fsync before rename; the all-or-nothing state file; no rollback to a version 1 hub; turns ending without Stop get no summary
why: each follows the spec's chosen signal or predates milestone 3; the cost if wrong is a missing notice or a late summary, never lost work

decision: deferred minors: a summary in flight across /clear lands on the new conversation; a deleted task may stay counted; the window title keeps its count while disconnected; summarizer slots are never pruned; close() leaves a request in flight; a tmux server the hub starts lives in the hub's cgroup; the hub drops a reply when a client half-closes right after asking; the Windows workflow's actions still target Node 20
why: each is cosmetic, rare, or predates milestone 3
evidence: final review Minors 3 and 8 plus own observations
